entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An Avishkari inventor of lifelike constructs, a former planeswalker who loses her spark in the Desparkening and settles on Ixalan with Huatli.

entities.name: Aarav
entities.description: Saheeli's father.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A warrior-poet planeswalker and Saheeli's romantic partner, who loses her spark and lives on Ixalan.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Saheeli's home plane of inventors, centered on Ghirapur.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The Kaladeshi city where Saheeli studied at the Institute of Art and Science.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where Saheeli resides after losing her spark.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An elf inventor, Saheeli's friend, who worked on the aether teleporter.

entities.name: Mitul
entities.description: A vedalken inventor who worked with Rashmi on an aether teleporter.

entities.name: Padeem
entities.description: One of the Consuls Saheeli has an audience with.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who stages a coup on Kaladesh and hides in the Aether Spire.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: The revolt against the Consulate that Saheeli joins.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The ruling authority of Kaladesh whose Spire the Renegades attack.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A band of planeswalkers who aid the Renegades and fight Bolas.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who accompanies Saheeli into the Aether Spire.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A Renegade leader who builds Hope of Ghirapur with Saheeli and defends Kaladesh from the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who offers Saheeli a place with the Gatewatch and disables the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker whose plan kills Bolas and whose memorial Saheeli attends.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A Consulate figure who sabotaged the Hope of Ghirapur and runs the Immortal Sun facility.

entities.name: Hope of Ghirapur
entities.description: A thopter Saheeli and Rashmi built to destroy Tezzeret's planar bridge.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon who traps planeswalkers on Ravnica with the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Bolas's artifact that traps planeswalkers on Ravnica, repeatedly disabled and reactivated.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: A shapeshifter who disguises himself as Chandra and later as Saheeli.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: A Ravnican tasked with shutting off the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A planeswalker who flirts with Saheeli and considers stealing her jewelry.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who tells Saheeli to disable the Sun so Ugin can leave.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A Spirit Dragon planeswalker who leaves with Bolas's body.

entities.name: Teyo
entities.description: A character who wonders what happened to the real Saheeli.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: An ancient artifact whose replica Saheeli built after Karn's was destroyed.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: A time-travel device Saheeli built in Urza's Tower.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who is left unconscious in the Stasis Coffin when the Anchor explodes.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who works with Saheeli and Teferi on a past-based solution.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A character who stays with Saheeli to save Teferi.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault in which Saheeli defends Kaladesh.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: The plane that replaced New Phyrexia and where survivors gather.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A Strixhaven scholar who joins Saheeli's Ixalan expedition.

entities.name: Apatzec Intli IV
entities.description: The boy-emperor of the Sun Empire who commissions Saheeli's automatons.

entities.name: Atlacan Huicintli
entities.description: Apatzec's uncle, who controls the young emperor.

entities.name: Caztaca Huicintli
entities.description: The emperor's aunt, whom Saheeli and Huatli seek out to change her brother's heart.

entities.name: Elenda
entities.description: A leader of Garrano who negotiates an alliance.

entities.name: Beckett Brass
entities.description: An admiral who demands support for the Brazen Coalition.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The Ixalan empire that employs Saheeli.

entities.name: Echoverse Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An alternate-reality Saheeli who is consul of oversight, spying on Avishkar through thopters.

events.summary: Saheeli, reluctant at first, agrees to help Rashmi and Mitul with their aether teleporter after being reminded that innovation has no boundaries.
events.quote: she refused to help them, fearing what could happen to Kaladesh if such an invention came into wide usage

events.summary: After Tezzeret's coup, Saheeli joins the Renegades and Gatewatch and, with Liliana, breaks into the Aether Spire, finding Rashmi gone and the invention rebuilt.
events.quote: Saheeli joined forces with the Renegades and the newly arrived Gatewatch .

events.summary: Saheeli and Pia build the thopter Hope of Ghirapur against Tezzeret's bridge, defend the Heart of Kiran, and decline Chandra's offer to join the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Saheeli declined, stating that there would be much to do in the aftermath of the revolt on Kaladesh.

events.summary: Huatli arrives on Ghirapur on her first planeswalk and Saheeli recognizes her as a planeswalker.
events.quote: she was quickly recognized for what she was by Saheeli

events.summary: Saheeli and Huatli begin a relationship.
events.quote: she began a relationship with Huatli.

events.summary: Saheeli and Huatli are lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon and trapped by the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun

events.summary: Lazav disguises himself as Chandra to distract Dovin Baan, letting Chandra disable the Immortal Sun, and Lazav defeats Baan.
events.quote: Lazav defeated Baan, blinding him with throwing stars and causing him to planeswalk away.

events.summary: Chandra reactivates the Immortal Sun and leaves Saheeli to guard it; after Bolas's defeat Saheeli disables it again on Jace's unknown plan to let Ugin and Liliana leave.
events.quote: After Bolas' defeat, Saheeli disabled the Immortal Sun for a second time.

events.summary: Lazav, disguised as Saheeli, attends the Planewide Celebration, leaving Teyo to wonder where the real Saheeli is.
events.quote: it turned out to be Lazav disguised as her, leaving Teyo to wonder what happened to the real Saheeli

events.summary: Saheeli attends Gideon's memorial on Theros.
events.quote: Saheeli participated in the memorial service for Gideon on Theros .

events.summary: Saheeli re-creates the Golgothian Sylex and, with Teferi and Kaya, builds the Temporal Anchor to find a solution in the past.
events.quote: she built the Temporal Anchor in Urza's Tower .

events.summary: The powerstone in the Anchor explodes, leaving Teferi unconscious, and Saheeli stays with Jodah to save him.
events.quote: Saheeli chose instead to stay behind with Jodah to try to save him

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Saheeli joins Pia in defending Kaladesh with robotic dinosaurs in Operation Golden Scales.
events.quote: Saheeli joined Pia Nalaar in the defense of Kaladesh.

events.summary: Saheeli joins the survivors on Zhalfir and deduces the suns of Mirrodin now orbit it.
events.quote: Saheeli joined the Mirran survivors and other surviving planeswalkers on Zhalfir .

events.summary: Saheeli and Huatli lose their sparks in the Desparkening and Saheeli joins her on Ixalan.
events.quote: both Saheeli and her partner Huatli lost their sparks in the Desparkening

events.summary: Saheeli enters the Sun Empire's employ building mechanoquetzacama for the boy-emperor.
events.quote: The emperor commissioned her to create more of these creations, providing her with every resource in his empire.

events.summary: Saheeli lies about summoning help from Strixhaven and Ghirapur but enlists Quintorius Kand for an expedition below Orazca.
events.quote: Saheeli had lied about contacting her home plane

events.summary: Saheeli and Huatli conspire to depose Atlacan and enlist Caztaca to prevent another war.
events.quote: both she and Huatli conspired to depose Atlacan Huicintli

events.summary: Saheeli serves as Caztaca's scribe at a meeting with Elenda and Beckett Brass, convinces them to accept a deal and seals the treaty.
events.quote: In the end, Saheeli convinced the other two leaders to accept the deal.

events.summary: Saheeli leaves Ixalan and returns to Avishkar.
events.quote: she left Ixalan and returned to Avishkar
